name: Coupa
description: Connect your own Coupa Business Spend Management instance through OAuth2 client credentials. Read and safely manage Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Invoices, Suppliers, Contracts, and Expense Reports through the instance's licensed Core API modules.

tools.name: connect_coupa
tools.description: Connect a Coupa instance (OAuth2 client credentials), after validating connectivity.

instance_url.description: Coupa instance base URL, e.g. https://acme.coupahost.com.
instance_url.title: Instance Url

client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID issued via Coupa admin (Setup > OAuth2/OpenID Connect Clients).
client_id.title: Client Id

client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret for that client.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

tools.name: disconnect_coupa
tools.description: Disconnect one Coupa instance: deletes only the credentials saved in Imperal. Nothing is changed in Coupa.

connection_id.description: Saved Coupa instance connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_requisitions
tools.description: List Requisitions on the connected Coupa instance, optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

status.description: Optional requisition status filter, e.g. approved, pending_approval.
status.title: Status

tools.name: get_requisition
tools.description: Read one Requisition in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_requisition
tools.description: Create a new Requisition with line items.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

requested_by_email.description: Email of the Coupa user this requisition is created for.
requested_by_email.title: Requested By Email

lines.description: List of {description, quantity, price, need_by_date} line dicts.
lines.title: Lines

tools.name: list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List Purchase Orders, optionally filtered by supplier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_purchase_order
tools.description: Read one Purchase Order in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List Invoices, optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

status.description: Optional invoice status filter, e.g. approved, disputed, pending_approval.
status.title: Status

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Read one Invoice in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_suppliers
tools.description: List Suppliers registered on this Coupa instance.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Read one Supplier in full by its Supplier ID.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: List Contracts, optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: Read one Contract in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_expense_reports
tools.description: List Expense Reports, optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_expense_report
tools.description: Read one Expense Report in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: audit_coupa_access
tools.description: Probe every core Coupa Core API module (Requisitions, POs, Invoices, Suppliers, Contracts, Expense Reports) and report which are actually enabled for this instance, without changing anything.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Coupa instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: coupa_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected Coupa instances and encrypted OAuth credentials. Managed only through connect_coupa and disconnect_coupa.
